usable_for: calibrating that the triage reads real WebShop observation text (prices, buttons, "Invalid format" feedback)
reasons: No per-step environment reward and no availability list in the source, so grounding can only measure parseability.
803 of 1170 assistant turns are unparsable (truncated generation), so a trajectory-level label mixes real failure with broken generation.
agent_final_reward is only 0 or 1: 77 of 78 trajectories are 0 while every trajectory still contains a purchase action.
These are upstream demo trajectories, not this group's model output.
consequence: Use them to calibrate parsing only. Real failure cases (format/retrieval/specification/budget/loop) must come from webshop-lab rollout logs on our own tasks.
